# comporu/cache

> 标签: apc, cache, file, memcached, mongo, mysql, redis

## 简介

Provides an cache interface for several adapters (Apc, File, Mongo, Memcached, Mysql, ... )

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。
